newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal says central bank law meets EMU needs.
newsitem.headline: Portugal says central bank law meets EMU needs.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is fully independent, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said, dismissing suggestions that Portugal's central bank might not meet requirements for entry to the single currency.

A leading economist with the opposition Social Democratic Party had suggested on Thursday that references to the Bank in Portugal's constitution could need reforming to bring them into line with European Union requirements on independence.

"If the question is put in those terms, then it is not necessary to revoke the article (in the constitution)," Sousa Franco said. "It has no impact on Portugal's entry into the euro (single currency)," he told journalists.
But the minister said that the government was willing to discuss ways of improving the wording of the constitution in its references to the central bank.
